The intern will operate various laboratory equipment, document lab results, complete data entry, and help prepare presentations and reports.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Assist R&D staff with the set up, operation and documentation of research projects.
Formulate various materials to customer or internal specifications for evaluation.
Work alongside the team evaluating various properties and effectiveness of personal care, home care, industrial, and other applications as required.
Operate testing equipment safely, accurately and efficiently.
Organize and complete data entry of analytical results and help create appropriate technical reports and/or presentations as required.
Share project status, updates and results with the R&D team and [Company name masked] R&D leadership.
Perform laboratory cleanup of equipment, glassware, sample bottles and work areas.
Maintain a neat and safe work area, adhering to all safety policies and procedures.
Carry out any tasks or other reasonable duties as requested.
cond_0648.requirements:
Completion of Junior year in a B.S. Program in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related science as minimum.
Bachelor's degree in chemistry or science-related field is preferred.
Completion of one year of college level Organic Chemistry.
Experience working in a laboratory environment.
Understanding of chemical interactions and hazards.
Ability to work with and around various laboratory chemicals safely.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient computer skills for data entry, data evaluation, report development, and file organization.
Strong problem solving and organizational skills.
